title: Aeon Circuit environment construction and worldbuilding: functional 32px rooms and A20
summary: Evidence-backed synthesis of architecture-first level design: facility purpose and causality; diegetic/formal circulation and reachability; landmark hierarchy, authentic tile and object layers; localized decay; visual depth, door occlusion, lighting, runtime screenshots and owner-approval gates. Applied privately to one noncanonical A20 QA room with unchanged original Ghost Signal engine and separate source-art layers. This record is not a complete, canonical or owner-approved campaign map.
